title: Quantized Energy and Atomic Energy Levels
purpose: Explain quantized energy at the atomic level.
labDataRequirement: Energy level model and spectrum evidence analysis
safetyNotes: Use virtual spectra and diagrams only. No flame tests unless TOR/school-assigned.
simulationReview: Direct simulation/resource link is provided in P01.html and in directSimulationUrl.
assessmentStimulusNeeded: Energy level diagram or emission/absorption model
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for atomic models, periodic trends, energy levels, and spectra
directSimulationTitle: PhET Models of the Hydrogen Atom
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the hydrogen atom model and turn on the light or spectrum display if it is available. Compare at least two model views or settings that show electron energy behavior. Observe the emitted or absorbed light pattern and connect each visible line or color to an energy change. Record the model used, the spectrum evidence observed, and one sentence connecting quantized energy levels to Quantized Energy and Atomic Energy Levels.
